current_priority.title: Prepare TYME Hall for independent context-zero review
current_priority.summary: Align the public doorway, current-state projection, machine bootstrap and contribution path so an external human or machine can reconstruct the institution without private coaching.

active_matters.title: Public Office projection
active_matters.summary: A read-only Office surface is being used to expose approved present state without making the public interface an authority source.

active_matters.title: Context-zero validation
active_matters.summary: Independent reviewers receive only the public Hall and are expected to report ambiguity, unsupported inference, stale state and broken provenance rather than being coached toward intended answers.

change_log.title: SIRI Publication 001 published
change_log.summary: AGI-0001 crossed the explicit publication gate and is preserved as PUBLISHED_CANONICAL with public provenance and machine-readable publication metadata.

change_log.title: Public surface doctrine frozen
change_log.summary: Office, Scrolls, Laboratory, Constellation and Contribution are the five public relationships to institutional knowledge used for the next review cycle.

waiting.title: Automatic Office generation
waiting.summary: Automatic mutation or publication remains withheld until the read-only projection survives external review and the source/projection boundary is proven.

human_review.title: Review cold-start release candidate
human_review.summary: Confirm public state accuracy, safe references, epistemic boundaries and doorway coherence before promotion to the production branch.

recent_returns.title: Public Office contract validated in Tyme-Lab
recent_returns.summary: The public Office schema, fail-closed validator, tests and minimal fixture are retained on Tyme-Lab main as the contract basis for this renderer.

surface_updates.change: Read-only public current-state projection prepared for external cold-start review.
The first canonical SIRI Scroll is publicly inspectable with machine-readable publication metadata.
Experimental work remains explicitly non-canonical and is exposed only where its evidence posture can be stated clearly.
Relational navigation remains derived from preserved system relationships rather than becoming a second authority source.
Challenge, correction and reproduction remain valid entry paths without implying institutional authority.

contribution_entry_points.title: Challenge a public claim or boundary
contribution_entry_points.description: Trace the public evidence, identify a contradiction, unsupported inference, reproducibility problem, stale state or unclear definition, and return the correction through the public repository path.

public_notice: This is a read-only public projection of approved institutional state. It does not grant authority, expose private deliberation, or replace repository and governance sources of truth. External reviewers should report contradictions instead of resolving them by assumption.
